description: A person spends several minutes on the front porch repeatedly trying the door, walks off and comes back with a second person, and both linger at the door before leaving.
Several people come and go at the front gate, and near the end two men wheel a motorcycle out through the gate and take it away down the street.
The night courtyard sits still for over three minutes before a person slips in, crouches by the covered motorcycle, and wheels it out through the gate.
A hooded person pries at the back door with a tool until it gives way, slips inside, and comes back out carrying a light-colored object.
A man walks up the brick driveway, gets into the house, and spends about two minutes moving through the living room and kitchen, picking up items from the shelves before leaving.
A quiet daytime driveway with a parked silver car, passing street traffic, and one distant pedestrian; no one approaches the house.
An elevated daytime view of a residential street where pedestrians stroll past parked cars and someone walks a dog; nothing approaches the homes.
Two people slip into the yard at night, pull the cover off a parked motorcycle, work on it for over a minute, and wheel it away, leaving the cover behind.
A person rides a bicycle into the gated driveway at night, opens the parked SUV's rear door, and rummages inside it twice before riding off.
A person walks into the driveway at night, moves between the parked car and pickup for about a minute, and the camera view whites out at the end as if covered.
At night a group gathers at the front gate around a motorcycle, works on it for several minutes, and wheels it out onto the street and away.
Two people move through a home's kitchen and living room, looking around the counters and windows, and the blinds are drawn partway through the clip.
A black-and-white view of a terraced street lined with parked cars stays quiet for the whole clip, with no one approaching the houses.
A Nest camera watches an empty kitchen for most of the clip, but midway through a person in a red shirt walks in from the back rooms and bends over the furniture as if searching it.
On a rainy night two hooded figures crowd around the driver-side door of the SUV parked in the driveway, and a car is driven away from the curb moments later.
Before dawn the door of the white hatchback parked on the street is opened, its headlights come on, and the car is driven away, leaving the street quiet again.
A person appears at the rear of the white hatchback in the driveway late in the clip, then walks away across the street carrying a light-colored item.
A person opens the driver door of the pickup in the driveway at about 1 AM and leans into the cab again and again for roughly two minutes before leaving.
A hooded person walks along the terraced street at night, stops at the black car parked at the curb, and leans at its driver-side window for about half a minute before walking off.
An elevated daytime view over a small parking area where pedestrians stroll past parked cars and a motorcyclist stops briefly; nothing is taken from any vehicle in view.
A night view over parked cars stays still for seven minutes, with only a passing car's headlights crossing the top of the frame near the end.
A hooded person enters the walled brick driveway at night and spends minutes leaning into the parked car, leaves, and later returns to work at the car again.
